pairing.off: existing frozen v3 generation without lexicon addendum
pairing.on: identical generation plus pinned ATTRIB+BOUND lexicon, full detail, all17 B/S/J rows
controls: no identities or source-page metadata in prompts
pairing.scope: generation-time pass-2 prose guidance; pass-1 extraction held fixed and recorded
pairing.method: Reuse the exact committed pass-1 facts for both writing arms, with the same image included in both _weave_messages calls. Do not pair a live image weave against text-only weave-bench: that would change two variables. Counterbalance writing-arm order, preserve errors and separate shared extraction clocks.
pairing.failed_pairs: retain parse errors, timeouts and raw outputs in denominator; no selective retries
pairing.runtime: one GPU model resident at a time; new bounded maintenance window, restore original service and STOP/AUTO after each residency; no old queues resumed

quality.primary: blinded usable-description rate: valid contract, no materially unsupported claim, all purpose-critical facts retained
quality.annotation: human required/allowed/prohibited fact units from pixels and permitted context before viewing candidate outputs; two raters with adjudication; Luna metadata classification is not human gold
quality.analysis: paired on-minus-off effects per model; source-cluster uncertainty intervals and discordant pairs; original/new split and per-stratum denominators
quality.margin: proposed5percentage-point usable-rate margin requires owner ratification and sample/power assessment before a confirmatory promotion gate
quality.sample_size_limit: 120 is an exploratory coverage target, not a powered parity claim
quality.promotion: no automatic promotion or unvalidated model judge; choose lower latency among candidates meeting ratified quality floors; retain uncertainty and expand if unresolved

evidence.rationale: JOY-LEASE-G5 (codex gpt-6.1-sol xhigh, independent) PASS on R6 head ddd3da7e: actual guest.py clock entry reports clock_bounds_unavailable; lifecycle refuses before START/POST/lease/unit incl. except/finally; G2/G3/G4 intact; no deadline extension; 6 independent checks + 5 clock mutants detected. One low advisory (JOY-LEASE-G5-ADV-01, test gap, no prod change; deferred). G5 advisory: A and B rejections sound; only rigorous alternative is a same-clock nonrenewable expiry fence with qualified revocation latency, which no supplied primitive provides (architecture/producer-contract change). CANON PROPOSAL (AGT-12 timebox after 6 authors at same obstacle; AGT-10 degrade loudly; CARD-03 designed-unknown; AGT-08 precondition at caller): Joy live acquisition is NOT admissible; report Joy actual rows as 'blocked: native clock lease unqualified' with the PASS-verified refusal evidence, never fabricate or substitute rows; do not spend further author/gate cycles on Joy admission without a user-authorized architecture change (same-clock fence). JOY-AB-ADJ-R3 (dispatched 04:19Z) allowed to settle (sunk, cheap) but its 4th-dispatch Sol gate is deferred: no consumer until Joy acquisition is admissible. Bakeoff priority shifts to Qwen/Inc/MiMo038 rows (blocked on VM root-disk guard, operator cleanup).
